scope: Independent read-only semantic review of root historical character seven restorations. No production source or tests were modified by this review.
reviewType: Static code/ownership/consumer analysis with regression test source inspection; test execution and final integration results are owned by root.

items.reason: The constructor owns its CatmullRomCurve3; point/tangent requests share the identical i/N arclength mapping without a mutation callback between them. getPoint(t) and getTangent(t).normalize() retain the original operations after mapping.
items.testsInspected: Real Three.js geometry across straight/curved/degenerate curves, 24 surface cases, tube and suction geometry exact bytes, mapping call counts.

items.reason: earFrame width(u) is independent of sx. Each row has the same uc, w, resolution and antihelix inputs for both ears. Only read-only scalar [X,Y] rows are shared within one build; each ear retains separate frames, vertices, weights and winding. buildFaceSkin owns acc and invokes no external callback between ears.
items.testsInspected: Exact face geometry attributes/index, AO, weights and other accumulators across all 12 quality/LOD combinations.

items.reason: Ring kernels are rebuilt per eye so Builder.add cornea mutations affect the next eye. Only own numeric cornea uses ring reuse; accessors and nonnumeric values retain per-vertex reads/coercions. The derivative scratch never escapes. Azimuth operands and arithmetic are unchanged.
items.testsInspected: Both eye geometry and shader sphere data exact; Builder mutation between eyes and changing cornea accessor read order exact.

items.reason: The private original damp(a,b,l,dt) is a+(b-a)*(1-exp(-l*dt)); private lerp has exactly a+(b-a)*t. lk and dt are unchanged scalar locals across the six-element loop. The hoist preserves this arithmetic and computes the shared alpha once.
items.testsInspected: Actual source-loaded Character poses, skeleton, hair, springs, stance and RNG at 30/60/120 Hz, zero dt and hitch dt.

items.reason: The only production limbPath callers create fresh numeric Vector3 clones of REST. The bounded four-entry cache compares every coordinate using Object.is and holds only sampled P/S/len. A fresh path/at closure retains each call live lateral hint, and at copies sampled points into caller-owned output; neither table nor vectors escape.
items.testsInspected: Different live hints, returned-path isolation, mutated output isolation, coordinate invalidation over nine changes, bounded four-entry cache, one 601-point sampling on repeated coordinates, and actual actor mesh equality.

items.reason: Only private strapPaths-owned unmutated polylines are registered in the WeakMap. Each block AABB includes both endpoints of all covered line segments. Rejecting boxes farther than .03+1e-9 on any axis is conservative for the sole consumer which ignores distances >.03. Unregistered polylines always use the complete original segment walk. No poly sample is exposed through a production export or Builder callback.
items.testsInspected: 3600 near-boundary distance checks preserve cutoff and exact accepted distances; 600 real teeFold results exact; mutable unowned polylines keep full distances.

items.reason: Numeric tilt cache uses Object.is, preserving signed-zero and nonfinite keys; the current tank center is always read. Nonnumeric tilt uses the original cos/sin evaluations on each call, retaining valueOf order.
items.testsInspected: Exact scalar, signed-zero, nonfinite, undefined/null and changing valueOf outputs; warm numeric calls omit exactly 1000 sin and cos calls.

limitations: This review makes no device/GPU benchmark claim. Test outcomes must be taken from the actual root validation log, not inferred from test source inspection.
The code is judged against production module contracts and actual callbacks/exports; arbitrary replacement of builtin Math or Three.js prototypes is not a supported production mutation contract.
